text.en: Long ago, Tamil scholars sorted living things by how many senses they have.

Uyirvagai classifies living beings by the number of senses: one-sense (ஓரறிவு) beings such as plants feel by touch, two-sense beings add taste, and so on up to six-sense (ஆறறிவு) human beings who have a mind. This classification comes from the Tholkappiyam, the oldest Tamil grammar.
The classification shows that ancient Tamils observed nature carefully. The memorisation poem in the textbook gives this order of beings.
Terms: உயிர்வகை (kinds of life), ஓரறிவு to ஆறறிவு, தொல்காப்பியம் and மனம் (mind).
